name: BACH_0356
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (96%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set and full model agreement support this [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 96%, Invasive 3% | One dominant class |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 99% / OOD percentile 100% | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 InSitu [F5] | Neighbors agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 5, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; strongest concept-model term against invasive · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Scarce here; concept model links scarcity to invasive · Validated
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 4, 9, 10) · context · At reference maximum; mean nuclear area at reference minimum · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002, CI −0.005 to 0.007 includes 0: not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Regions 9 and 10 score 70% and 84% invasive per region, against 3% overall.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 10**: look for stromal invasion; per-region invasive scores are 70% and 84%.
2. **Regions 0, 5, 10**: confirm atypical cells stay inside ducts; this concept passed 12/20 spot checks.
3. **Region 4**: check for tumor-infiltrating stroma; per-region invasive score is 57%.
